description: Amazon DSP Firefly DoubleVerify measurement hops on vfw.amazon-adsystem.com/dv/event.png and /dv/proxy/sts.png. The measurement contract requires vstevt and validates supplied ctx, cmp, plc, and sid from DoubleVerify dvparams. Other /dv/ routes, including /dv/vtrk.doubleverify.com/ wrapper telemetry, are not covered by this pack. The proxy verification-error variant remains subject to the existing vstevt requirement pending an authoritative contract. IAS /ias/ hops on the same host are not contracted. The Ad Tag loader is vendor/amazon-ads.

params.name: vstevt
params.description: It is the Firefly viewability event code on the contracted /dv/event.png and /dv/proxy/sts.png measurement hops. The linked Amazon policy is ecosystem context, not a specification of this query. The existing measurement contract requires a non-empty value; proxy verification-error variants need a separate authoritative contract before that requirement can change.
params.fix_hint: Export the Firefly VAST again from Amazon DSP so vstevt is present on the /dv/ hop.

params.name: ctx
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify context or advertiser key. Google documents it as ctx inside dvparams. Generated /dv/proxy tags carry the same name. Quartile /dv/event.png hops often omit it.
params.fix_hint: Keep ctx from the generated Firefly /dv/proxy tag, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: cmp
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify campaign key. Google documents it as cmp inside dvparams. Generated /dv/proxy tags carry the same name.
params.fix_hint: Keep cmp from the generated Firefly /dv/proxy tag, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: plc
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify placement key. Google documents it as plc inside dvparams. Generated /dv/proxy tags carry the same name.
params.fix_hint: Keep plc from the generated Firefly /dv/proxy tag, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: sid
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify site or supply key. Google documents it as sid inside dvparams. Generated /dv/proxy tags carry the same name. Values may be a name rather than digits.
params.fix_hint: Keep sid from the generated Firefly /dv/proxy tag, or drop the empty pair.
